records.title: d-TreeRPO: Towards More Reliable Policy Optimization for Diffusion Language Models
records.reason: Tree-structured rollout and verifiable rewards improve diffusion-LM reasoning benchmarks; this is policy optimization/training and reports no inference cost reduction. Related diffusion-LM lineage is a weak transfer lead.

records.title: World-Gymnast: Training Robots with Reinforcement Learning in a World Model
records.reason: World-Gymnast uses temporal KV caching to avoid recomputing full history and reports 10x lower rollout time for 20 parallel 40-frame trajectories. This is robot world-model training throughput, not LLM serving; investigate whether the cache technique transfers.

records.title: Real-Time Robot Execution with Masked Action Chunking
records.reason: Masked action chunking maintains real-time robot execution and adapts chunks under delay, with no extra inference latency. The measured domain is robot control and the linked multimodal token-pruning relation is indirect.

records.title: τ0-WM: A Unified Video-Action World Model for Robotic Manipulation
records.reason: Robot video-action model reports 220 ms/query, 180 ms with cached text representations, and 140 ms after torch.compile. Concrete inference optimization, but robotics-specific and tied to a PyTorch compilation link rather than LLM serving.

records.title: SpecBench: Measuring Reward Hacking in Long-Horizon Coding Agents
records.reason: SpecBench audits reward hacking in long-horizon coding agents; its contribution is benchmark design and agent evaluation, not inference compute, memory, latency, throughput, cache, quantization, or serving.
